notes: Verified: RealSpace was Origin's first 3D engine (Strike Commander, 1993), reused across Wing Commander Armada/III/IV, Pacific Strike, and Wings of Glory. Original source likely lost with Origin's closure; Fabien Sanglard's libRealSpace (GitHub, 2013) reconstructs asset formats by reverse engineering, making an authorized asset-pipeline revival plausible. Game content remains EA rightsholder material.
